paper_title: Experimental search for invisible dark matter axions around 22 μeV
notes: The paper reports exclusion of dark matter axions with g_agamma >= 0.93*g_KSVZ over 21.86-22.00 ueV at 90% CL. The KSVZ coupling at ~22 ueV (~5.3 GHz) is roughly g_KSVZ ~ 2.9e-15 GeV^-1, so 0.93*g_KSVZ ~ 2.7e-15 GeV^-1. The emitted coupling value is an approximation of the absolute g_agamma; the paper's actual quoted result is in units of KSVZ coupling. Mass range 21.86-22.00 ueV = 2.186e-5 to 2.200e-5 eV.
